parameters.query: INSERT INTO call_logs (caller_number, vapi_call_id, transcript, summary, duration, intent, call_status, recording_url, cost) VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, ''), $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, NULLIF($8, ''), $9) ON CONFLICT (vapi_call_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, intent = EXCLUDED.intent, duration = EXCLUDED.duration, call_status = EXCLUDED.call_status RETURNING id
